blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Auditing whether a text-to-image (T2I) model was fine-tuned on a particular image collection is difficult: a model can absorb collection-level visual characteristics without reproducing training images. Proactive dataset-use auditing plants a shared signal in a dataset before release, then later checks whether that signal appears in a suspect model's generated outputs. Existing approaches often trade off verifiability, fidelity, robustness, and deployability. We introduce $\textbf{SpectralCanary}$, which uses a smooth low-pass mask to blend a fixed canary image into every collection image while leaving captions unchanged and requiring neither auxiliary generation nor per-image optimization. A lightweight verifier detects the transferred signal in suspect-model outputs. Across eight tests on the Pokemon dataset and three realistic data transformations, spanning two architectures families, SpectralCanary achieves the highest average per-generation TPR@$1\%$ FPR ($91.1\%$) and fixed threshold model-level accuracy using 30 generations ($94.8\%$) among the evaluated methods. Across five datasets spanning artistic, medical, satellite, and fashion domains with SD3.5, SpectralCanary averages $92.4\%$ per-generation TPR@$1\%$ FPR while preserving the released images (SSIM $0.989$, LPIPS $0.022$) with a near-zero mean change FID (mean $Δ$FID $0.05$) across datasets. Matched-energy ablations on Pokemon and ROCOv2 support our design choice, low-frequency placement transfers more reliably compared to mid/high-frequency placement. Under the evaluated adaptive attacks, the most effective removal requires aggressive modification and incurs more than $25$ $Δ$FID points. These results identify low-frequency visual signals as effective carriers for collection-level T2I audit traces.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Creative and scientific image collections embody substantial human labor, expertise, and investment. Adapting text-to-image (T2I) models to such collections can support legitimate personalization, education, design, and scientific communication [ 26 , 7 , 11 ] . The same capability, however, allows a third party to fine-tune and deploy a model on a collection without the rights holder’s consent, attribution, or compensation. Because a model can absorb a collection’s visual characteristics without reproducing individual images, rights holders may have little evidence that their work was used [ 21 , 13 ] . Practical dataset-use auditing can strengthen accountability and licensing compliance while allowing images to remain available for legitimate use.
blocks.zh: 创造性和科学形象的收集体现了大量的人力、专门知识和投资。 使文本化成图像(T2I)模型适应这些收藏可以支持合法的个性化,教育,设计和科学交流[26,7,11]. 然而,同样的能力允许第三方在未经权利持有人同意、归属或补偿的情况下,对募集物进行微调和部署模型。 由于一个模型可以吸收一个收藏的视觉特征而不复制个人图像,因此权利持有者可能没有多少证据证明他们的作品被使用[21,13]. 实用的数据集使用审计可以加强问责制和遵守许可证规定,同时允许图像继续供合法使用。

blocks.en: We study proactive dataset-use auditing, commonly termed data traceability or unauthorized data-use verification in prior works. A practical method should satisfy four requirements. (Req. 1) Collection-level verifiability. It should provide evidence from black-box outputs even when no training image is reproduced. (Req. 2) Fidelity and utility preservation. Protected samples should preserve their original appearance and the utility of models trained on them, avoiding harm to legitimate use while resisting easy filtering. (Req. 3) Pipeline robustness. The trace should remain detectable across model architectures, after augmentation such as image regeneration or recaptioning. (Req. 4) Operational deployability. The protection transform should be model-agnostic and scale efficiently to large collections without auxiliary generation or iterative per-image optimization.
blocks.zh: 我们研究在以前的工程中主动进行数据集使用审计、通常称为数据可追溯性或未经授权的数据使用核查。 实用方法应满足四项要求。 收集一级可核查性。 即使没有复制培训图像,它也应提供黑盒输出的证据。 (Req. 2) Fieldity和公用事业维护。 被保护的样品应当保持其原始外观和对其加以培训的模型的效用,避免在抵制简单过滤的同时损害合法使用。 联合国 3)管道坚固. 在图像再生或再生等增强作用后,追踪应在整个模型结构中仍然可以探测出。 联合国 4)可操作性。 保护变换应该是模型不可知的,并且是高效的到大型收藏,而不需要辅助生成或迭代的每幅图像优化.

blocks.en: Prior approaches typically sacrifice at least one requirement. Reactive auditing: limited collection-level evidence (Req. 1). Membership and similarity tests rely on sample-specific evidence that generalization may erase [ 21 , 13 ] . Pixel-level watermarks: limited robustness (Req. 3). Weak signals may be attenuated by augmentation, regeneration, or fail to transfer across model backbones [ 34 , 13 ] . Explicit canaries: fidelity and robustness trade-offs (Reqs. 2–3). Repeated templates can be conspicuous and filterable, while recaptioning can remove textual triggers [ 25 ] . Adjacent data-poisoning objectives. Poisoning induces chosen behavior rather than provides evidence of dataset use. Persistent behavior may not be unique or reliably elicited, so it does not by itself establish use of a particular collection [ 33 , 12 ] . Across proactive methods, auxiliary generation, filtering, and iterative optimization can also limit deployability (Req. 4) by increasing computational cost or requiring external models, domain-specific assumptions [ 25 , 13 , 12 ] . These limitations motivate a subtle, transferable, caption-independent, and inexpensive trace.

blocks.en: We propose SpectralCanary , whose key design choice is the frequency band used for the shared trace. Before release, the dataset owner chooses one fixed canary image. For each collection image, SpectralCanary mixes a small amount of the canary’s low-frequency Fourier content into the original while retaining most of its spectrum and leaving its caption unchanged (Fig. 1 (b)). The protected spectra are thereby shifted toward a common low-frequency target, creating a collection-level signal. Low frequencies encode broad spatial structure that neural networks preferentially learn [ 24 , 37 ] and that is important to T2I generation [ 39 , 17 ] . This motivates our hypothesis that a weak low-frequency trace can transfer during fine-tuning. The dataset owner then queries a suspect model and uses a lightweight verifier to test whether its generated outputs contain the trace (Fig. 1 (a)). Importantly, SpectralCanary uses a single deterministic transform requiring no caption changes, auxiliary generator, or per-image optimization.

blocks.en: We evaluate all four requirements. Robustness tests cover a convolutional latent-diffusion U-Net [ 26 ] , a transformer-based rectified-flow model [ 7 ] ; data augmentation, image regeneration [ 42 ] , and recaptioning. Direct baselines include pixel-level traces (SIREN [ 13 ] , DIAGNOSIS [ 34 ] ) and explicit canaries (EnTruth [ 25 ] ). We also adapt Silent Branding [ 12 ] but report its evaluation separately in Appx. Q , because it targets visual branding rather than dataset-use auditing.

blocks.en: Auditing effectiveness and robustness. For per-generation discrimination, AUC measures verifier-score separation, while TPR at 1% FPR measures detection of outputs from protected-data models. Across eight Pokemon settings, SpectralCanary achieves 98.0% AUC and 91.1% TPR. In fixed-threshold model-level verification using 30 generations, it achieves 94.8% average accuracy under the same settings. Fidelity and utility preservation. SSIM and LPIPS compare original and protected images, while Δ \Delta FID measures the change in generative quality. Across five visual domains with SD3.5, SpectralCanary achieves 99.5 % 99.5\% AUC and 92.4 % 92.4\% TPR with SSIM 0.989 0.989 , LPIPS 0.022 0.022 , with a near-zero mean change FID ( Δ \Delta FID 0.05 0.05 ). On sparse Sketch-Scene drawings, it achieves 100 % 100\% AUC and TPR with SSIM 0.997 0.997 and LPIPS 0.002 0.002 . Operational deployability. Protection takes 0.39 0.39 seconds per image on our CPU setup (Appx. E ). Mechanism and boundary. In matched-energy ablations on Pokemon and ROCOv2, we show that low-frequency placement transfers more reliably compared to mid/high-frequency placement. Within the evaluated adaptive attacks, effective removal requires aggressive modification and incurs more than 25 25 Δ \Delta FID points.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are: • We identify low-frequency visual structure as an effective carrier for weak collection-level traces during T2I fine-tuning. In matched band size and perturbation energy ablations on Pokemon and ROCOv2 with SD1.5, we show that low-frequency placement yields higher per-generation TPR than mid/high-frequency placement. • We introduce SpectralCanary, a deterministic and caption-preserving spectral hybridization method. It protects each image with one inexpensive transform, requiring neither an auxiliary generator nor per-image optimization. • We jointly evaluate per-generation discrimination, KS-based multi-query auditing, fixed-threshold model-level verification, image fidelity, generative utility, robustness, and protection cost across two architecture families, five datasets, three direct auditing baselines, an adapted poisoning baseline, and three realistic data transformations. This evaluation establishes a strong empirical operating point and characterizes the boundary under adaptive spectral replacement.

blocks.en: 3 Related Work
blocks.zh: 3 相关工作

blocks.en: Reactive and proactive auditing. Reactive methods test an already trained model using membership inference or similarity between generated and reference images [ 3 , 21 , 23 , 19 ] . Such evidence can weaken when fine-tuning transfers collection-level characteristics without retaining identifiable information about individual samples. Proactive methods instead modify a collection before release. Anti-learning methods aim to prevent or redirect customization [ 30 , 43 , 32 , 1 , 15 ] . Proactive traceability aims to preserve customization utility while making later use statistically auditable.
blocks.zh: 积极而主动的审计. 反应方法利用成员推论或生成的图像与参考图像之间的相似性测试已经训练好的模型[3, 21, 23, 19]. 此类证据在微调转移收集一级特性时可能会被削弱,而不会保留关于单个样本的可识别信息。 主动方法代替在发布前修改集合. 反学习方法旨在防止或改变定制[30、43、32、1、15]。 积极主动的可追踪性旨在保持定制的效用,而后又在统计上加以审计。

blocks.en: Proactive traceability. Pixel-level methods such as DIAGNOSIS [ 34 ] and SIREN [ 13 ] insert weak transformations or learned signals that can be detected in generated images. Their subtle signals preserve appearance, but can be attenuated by augmentation, regeneration, or model backbone changes. EnTruth instead inserts explicit canary samples containing a repeated template and textual trigger [ 25 ] . This coherent signal can transfer strongly, but the injected samples are conspicuous and caption triggers can be removed. Our direct comparisons span the two main proactive families including subtle pixel-level traces and explicit visual canary samples.
blocks.zh: 主动可追溯. 像素级方法,如DIAGNOSIS [34]和SIREN [13] 插入能被从生成的图像中检测到的弱变换或已学到的信号. 它们的细微信号保存了外观,但可以通过增强,再生,或模型骨干变化来减弱. EnTruth转而插入含有重复模板和文字触发器的显式金丝雀样本 [25]. 这种连贯的信号可以强力传递,但被注入的样品是明显的,并可以去除标题触发. 我们直接比较了两个主要的主动家庭,包括微妙的像素水平的痕迹和明显的视觉金丝雀样本。

blocks.en: Relation to poisoning. Data poisoning induces chosen behaviors such as concept corruption, reproduction, or persistent branding [ 33 , 12 ] . Persistence alone is insufficient for auditing. Auditing instead requires a collection-specific signal detectable under ordinary, trigger-free queries with controlled false positives. SpectralCanary targets this auditing objective rather than model corruption. Appx. S provides further discussion and a method taxonomy.
blocks.zh: 与中毒有关. 数据中毒诱发了概念腐败,再生等被选择的行为,或者持续地打牌[33,12]. 仅靠持久性不足以进行审计。 相反,审计需要一种收集特定信号,在普通的,无触发的查询中可以检测到,并带有受控的假阳性. 光谱金库针对的是这一审计目标,而不是腐败模式。 Appx (英语). S提供了进一步讨论和方法分类。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup and How to Read the Results
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置和如何阅读结果

blocks.en: Our experiments ask four concrete questions. First, can SpectralCanary reveal that a model was trained on a protected collection, even when the model architecture or training data are changed? Second, does adding the trace visibly change the released images or make a model trained on them produce worse images? Third, is protection fast enough for a large collection? Finally, why do low frequencies matter, and what happens when an informed attacker tries to remove the trace?
blocks.zh: 我们的实验提出了四个具体的问题。 首先,Spectral Canary能否透露一个模型在被保护的收藏上接受了训练,即使模型架构或培训数据被改变? 第二,添加追踪是否明显地改变了释放的图像或使一个经过培训的模型产生更糟糕的图像? 第三,保护速度够快吗? 最后,为什么低频率很重要,当一个知情的攻击者试图去除追踪时会发生什么?

We cover distinct image domains: charater art (Pokemon-BLIP-Captions [ 22 ] ), sparse scene drawings (Sketch-Scene [ 4 ] ), medical (ROCOv2 [ 27 ] ), satellite (RSICD [ 16 ] ), and fashion (FACAD [ 38 ] ). We fine-tune Stable Diffusion v1.5 (SD1.5) [ 26 ] and Stable Diffusion 3.5 (SD3.5) [ 7 ] . The main experiments use LoRA, a common parameter-efficient form of T2I adaptation. Appx. On Pokemon, we test each method under ordinary training and after three realistic changes to the training set: image augmentation, diffusion-based recreation of each training image (image regeneration) [ 42 ] , and automatic recaptioning with Qwen2.5-VL 7B [ 2 ] .

blocks.en: How to read the metrics. We distinguish the embedded trace from two evaluation levels. Per-generation discrimination scores each generated image independently and asks whether outputs from protected-data models receive higher verifier scores than outputs from clean-data models. AUC summarizes this score separation over all thresholds. TPR at 1 % 1\% FPR is the fraction of outputs from protected-data models detected at a threshold that falsely flags at most 1 % 1\% of outputs from clean-data models; thus, a TPR of 90 % 90\% means detecting about 90 of 100 protected-data-model outputs while flagging about 1 of 100 clean-data-model outputs. At the model level, we evaluate two decision protocols. KS-based multi-query auditing combines scores from 30 generated images in a statistical test and reports the rejection rate on protected-data models. Fixed-threshold model-level verification aggregates 30 generations from each held-out model and applies a threshold fixed after independent calibration, reporting TPR, FPR, precision, F1, and accuracy (Appx. H ). For image fidelity, lower LPIPS [ 41 ] means that a protected image is closer to its original. For generated-image quality, Δ ​ FID = FID protected − FID clean \Delta\mathrm{FID}=\mathrm{FID}_{\mathrm{protected}}-\mathrm{FID}_{\mathrm{clean}} [ 28 ] ; values near or below zero indicate no measured quality loss, whereas large positive values indicate degradation. Unless stated otherwise, SpectralCanary uses α = 0.02 \alpha=0.02 , c = 0.20 c=0.20 , and δ = 1 \delta=1 . Every model-training and image-sampling setting is repeated with three independent runs. Detailed protocols are in Appx. A .

blocks.en: 5 Limitations and Responsible Use

blocks.en: Our evaluation covers two T2I architecture families, five datasets, and both LoRA and full-parameter fine-tuning. Although the phase-randomized controls in Appx. L isolate the role of spatial coherence, broader evaluation across independently chosen canary images and key reuse is needed.

blocks.en: SSIM, LPIPS, and FID capture only part of image fidelity and generative utility. Human perceptual studies and task-specific utility measurements would be needed to support stronger claims about invisibility or harmlessness. Likewise, our KS-test rejection rates on protected-data models estimate statistical power under the stated sampling protocol, while fixed-threshold model-level verification uses separate clean-data and protected-data models for calibration. A deployment would require broader calibration across representative clean-data models and should treat a positive result as statistical evidence under the threat model, not as standalone proof of unauthorized use.
blocks.zh: SSIM,LPIPS,和FID只捕捉到部分图像忠诚和基因效用. 需要进行人的感知研究和针对具体任务的公用事业测量,以支持人们更强烈的关于隐形或无害的说法。 同样,我们在保护-数据模型上的KS测试拒绝率估计了说明的采样协议下的统计功率,而固定阈值模型水平的验证则使用单独的清洁数据和被保护数据模型进行校正. 部署需要更广泛地校准具有代表性的清洁数据模型,并应将积极成果作为威胁模型下的统计证据,而不是未经授权使用的独立证据。

blocks.en: SpectralCanary is intended to help data owners audit model customization, but proactive traces can also be inserted into data without the knowledge of downstream users. Responsible use requires authorization to modify the collection, disclosure where appropriate, respect for dataset licenses, and safeguards against unsupported attribution. Decisions with legal or reputational consequences should combine the audit with independent evidence.
blocks.zh: Spectral Canary旨在帮助数据拥有者审计模式定制,但是在下游用户不知情的情况下,主动的痕迹也可以被插入到数据中. 负责任的使用需要授权修改收集、酌情披露、尊重数据集许可证以及防止无依据的归属。 具有法律或名誉后果的决定,应当将审计与独立证据相结合。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We propose SpectralCanary, a deterministic and inexpensive approach to proactive T2I dataset-use auditing. SpectralCanary injects a weak shared visual trace through a smooth low-pass mask while leaving captions unchanged. Across eight Pokemon model–transformation settings, it provides the strongest average per-generation discrimination and reliable KS-based multi-query auditing among the evaluated methods. The same operating point generalizes across five visual domains while preserving protected-image fidelity and generative utility. Matched-energy frequency-location experiments further show that low-frequency placement transfers more consistently than mid/high-frequency placement across datasets. Finally, the adaptive evaluation identifies a scoped robustness boundary, showing that the evaluated sanitization attacks substantially reduce per-generation TPR only at the cost of considerable image-quality or generative-utility degradation. Together, these results establish SpectralCanary as a practical method for T2I dataset-use auditing, while the limitations discussed above motivate future work.
blocks.zh: 我们提出Spectral Canary, 一种确定性和低廉的方法来进行积极主动的T2I数据集使用审计. Spectral Canary通过平滑的低通口罩注入了弱的共享视觉痕迹,而标题不变. 在8个Pokemon模型-转换设置中,它为每代人提供了最强的平均歧视和可靠的基于KS的多干法审计。 同一操作点一般跨越五个视觉领域,同时保留保护形象的忠诚性和基因效用。 相匹配的能频定位实验进一步表明,低频定位在数据集之间的传输比中高频定位更为一致. 最后,适应性评价确定了范围强的界限,表明经过评估的消毒攻击只是以相当的图像质量或基因效用退化为代价而大大减少了每代TPR. 这些结果共同确立了Spectral Canary作为T2I数据集使用审计的一种实用方法,而上文讨论的局限性则激励了今后的工作.

blocks.en: IAAFT randomizes the spatial organization of the fruit canary while preserving its empirical RGB value distribution and closely matching its channel-wise Fourier magnitude. Because the controls are constructed as real valued images before applying ℱ c \mathcal{F}_{c} , their spectra satisfy the required conjugate symmetry by construction. The fixed control uses the same IAAFT realization for every protected image. The independent control uses a different realization for each image. This comparison shows the contribution of natural spatial structure while approximately controlling spectral magnitude and pixel-value distribution. We characterize how well the spectral protection signal is learned by applying the verifier to generated samples and reporting AUC and TPR@FPR.

blocks.en: We visualize EnTruth’s injected and protected samples for the Pokemon setting in Fig. 20 . The injected samples are visually distinct from the original collection and require explicit trigger tokens in their captions. Moreover, EnTruth protects a dataset by inserting auxiliary templated samples rather than preserving the content of the original samples. blocks.en: Silent Branding depends on finding semantically appropriate regions and on auxiliary models for logo placement, detection, and refinement. In the Pokemon setting, its inserted signal transfers less consistently than SpectralCanary’s shared spectral component. This experiment shows that the evaluated branding pipeline is a weaker dataset-use auditing baseline under this protocol; it does not establish that all semantic insertion methods are unsuitable for dataset-use auditing.

blocks.en: Table 9 : Comparison of T2I data-poisoning and proactive dataset-use auditing methods. We consider methods that modify only the released training data and assume a standard training or fine-tuning pipeline. Content-preserving indicates that the modification does not intentionally alter the image’s original semantic content.
blocks.zh: 表9:T2I数据收集和主动数据集使用审计方法的比较。 我们考虑仅修改已公布的培训数据并承担标准培训或微调程序的方法。 内容保留表示修改不会有意改变图像的原始语义内容.

blocks.en: Reactive auditing. Reactive methods leave the released data unchanged and later test whether a model was trained on it. Membership inference estimates whether a particular image or prompt–image pair belonged to the training set; recent work studies this problem for fine-tuned diffusion models in black-box settings [ 3 , 21 , 44 , 45 ] . RECOVER [ 35 ] instead identifies individual fine-tuning images through their increased robustness under stochastic inversion–reconstruction, without modifying the images or requiring the pre-fine-tuned model. Other methods compare generated images with protected examples using representations such as CLIP [ 23 ] or DINO [ 19 ] . These methods apply to collections that have already been published, but their evidence can weaken when a T2I model generalizes without retaining identifiable information about individual samples [ 13 , 25 , 14 ] .
blocks.zh: 反应审计. 反应方法使所释放出的数据保持不变并随后测试一个模型是否在它上受过训练. 成员推断某一图像或即时图像对是否属于培训组;最近的工作研究了黑盒环境中的微调传播模型的问题[3、21、44、45]。 RECOVER [35] 转而识别个人微调图像,通过在分层倒置-重建下增强其坚固度,而不修改图像或要求预先调整的模型. 其他方法将生成的图像与使用CLIP[23]或DINO[19]等被保护实例进行比较. 这些方法适用于已经公布的集合,但是当一个T2I模型概括而未保留单个样本的可识别信息[13,25,14]时,其证据可能会被削弱.

blocks.en: Proactive protection and auditing. Anti-learning methods, including Glaze [ 30 ] , AdvDM [ 43 ] , Anti-DreamBooth [ 32 ] , FastProtect [ 1 ] , and MetaCloak [ 15 ] , modify images to prevent or redirect unauthorized customization. Proactive dataset-use auditing instead inserts a signal intended to transfer into the customized model. Its goal is not to make fine-tuning fail, but to make outputs from a model trained on the protected collection statistically distinguishable from outputs of clean-data reference models.
blocks.zh: 主动保护和审计。 反学习方法,包括Glaze [30],AdvDM [43],Anti-Dream Booth [32],快活保护 [1],和MetaCloak [15],修改图像以防止或改变未经授权的定制. 主动的数据集使用审计则插入一个信号,意在向定制模式转移。 它的目标不是使微调失败,而是使一个在统计学上受过保护收集培训的模型的产出与清洁数据参考模型的产出相区别。

blocks.en: Pixel-level traces. DIAGNOSIS [ 34 ] , DiffusionShield [ 6 ] , FT-Shield [ 5 ] , and SIREN [ 13 ] insert watermarks, transformations, or trigger-like signals that can later be detected in generated images. Their protected images remain close to the originals, but weak nonsemantic signals may be attenuated by image editing, regeneration, augmentation, or a change in T2I backbone. SpectralCanary shares the goal of preserving image appearance but uses a common low-frequency visual component rather than an optimized or pixel-local signal.
blocks.zh: 像素级的痕迹. DIAGNOSIS [34],分化屏蔽 [6],FT-屏蔽 [5],而SIREN [13] 插入水印,变换,或类似触发的信号,这些信号后来可以在生成的图像中被检测出. 其被保护的图像仍然与原作相近,但弱的非语义信号可能会被图像编辑,再生,增强,或T2I骨干的变化所削弱. Spectral Canary)共同的目标是保护图像外观,但使用常见的低频视觉组件,而不是优化或像素-局部信号.

blocks.en: Explicit visual canaries. EnTruth [ 25 ] inserts samples with a repeated visual template and a textual trigger. The coherent template transfers more readily than a weak pixel-level pattern, but the samples are visibly out of distribution (Appx. O ) and can be removed by visual filtering or caption cleaning. SpectralCanary instead distributes a weak version of the same visual component across the original collection and does not alter captions.
blocks.zh: 显相相相金刚. EnTruth [25] 插入带有重复视觉模板和文字触发的样本. 相通的模板比弱像素级模式更能容易地传输,但样本明显地脱离了分布(Appx. O.),可以通过视觉过滤或字幕清洗来取出. 光谱 取而代之的是将同一视觉组件的弱版本分出到原集中去,而不改变标题.

blocks.en: Relation to T2I data poisoning. Dataset-use auditing and data poisoning both modify training data so that the resulting model acquires an additional behavior [ 29 , 8 , 36 , 10 ] . BBadT2I [ 40 ] implants trigger-dependent pixel-, object-, or style-level behaviors. Nightshade [ 31 ] corrupts targeted concepts through modified image–text pairs, Bilateral Data Poisoning [ 20 ] induces persistent backdoor behavior, and SilentBadDiffusion [ 33 ] elicits attacker-specified content under trigger prompts. Silent Branding [ 12 ] is especially relevant because it modifies only images and induces reproduction of a repeated visual logo without a textual trigger. We adapt it as a dataset-use auditing baseline under the same downstream fine-tuning and auditing protocol (Appx. Q ).
blocks.zh: 与T2I数据中毒有关. 数据集使用审计和数据中毒两者都修改了培训数据,使生成的模型获得额外的行为[29,8,36,10]. BBadT2I [40] 被植入了触发-依赖像素-,对象-,或风格级的行为. Nightshade [31]通过修改后的形象-文本对子来腐蚀目标概念,双边数据中毒[20]诱发持续后门行为,而SilentBadDifusion[33]在触发提示下引出攻击者指定的内容. 静态品牌[12]特别相关,因为它只修改了图像并诱发了重复的视觉标志而无文字触发. 根据同样的下游微调和审计协议(Appx.Q.),我们把它作为数据集使用审计基线加以调整。
